summary: HDFC Bank Ltd. files a Form 6-K reporting that its board approved an extension of the interim part-time chairman's tenure by 3 months (to Sept. 18, 2026) and set the 32nd AGM for Aug. 5, 2026, recommending a Rs. 13 dividend per share. The chairman extension is a routine governance update, not a forced departure. This event is a low-impact board change with no activist or strategic contest. Watch for appointment of a regular chairman and shareholder approval of the dividend.
